_read_me: YOUR AGENCY IN ONE FILE. The first run copies this to agency/config.json (kept on this PC only, never uploaded: a tracked file edited on the PC would block the bot's auto-update). Change every YOUR ... word in agency/config.json, save, run RUN_AGENCY.bat again. The pitches, emails and demo sites read their names, numbers and prices from it.

agency.name: YOUR AGENCY
agency.postal_address: YOUR STREET ADDRESS, YOUR CITY, ST 00000
agency.tagline: Websites for local businesses, ready the same day

packages.name: Starter
packages.pitch: The site you saw, made yours: your photos and logo, your domain, the contact form, tap-to-call, hosting and small edits every month.
includes: The one-page site you saw, with your logo and photos
Your own domain with the padlock (https)
Contact form to your email, tap-to-call, map, hours
Hosting, backups and one small edit a month

packages.name: Growth
packages.pitch: Everything in Starter plus up to 5 pages (one per service), online booking or quote requests, and local Google basics.
includes: Up to 5 pages: a page for each main service
Local Google basics: titles, map listing, review link
Two edits a month and a short monthly report

packages.name: Pro
packages.pitch: A full custom site: up to 10 pages, the words written for you, a photo or menu section, and priority edits.
includes: Up to 10 pages, the words written for you
Review widget and a 'leave us a review' page
Priority edits within one business day
